name: Appraise
desc: You can show lost relics you've found to Professor Tangrowth, who will appraise them for you

name: Build
desc: Pokémon with the Build specialty will lead your building projects

name: Bulldoze
desc: Pokémon with the Bulldoze specialty can lead your demolition, rebuilding or relocation projects

name: Burn
desc: Pokémon with the Burn specialty can set fire to Flammable objects. They can also turn Squish clay into Brick

name: Chop
desc: Pokémon with the Chop specialty can process small logs into lumber

name: Collect
desc: Pokémon with the Collect specialty will trade you rare things for certain items

name: Crush
desc: Pokémon with the Crush specialty can mash materials into different things

name: DJ
desc: DJ Rotom can use the DJ specialty to play music CDs for you

name: Dream Island
desc: Pokémon with the Dream Island specialty can transport you to a Dream Island

name: Eat
desc: Mosslax has the Eat specialty. Something good may happen if you offer them food

name: Engineer
desc: Tinkmaster has the Engineer specialty and can lead huge building projects

name: Explode
desc: Pokémon with the Explode specialty can be fired out of a cannon, destroying everything around them on impact

name: Fly
desc: Pokémon with the Fly spceialty can fly you to a Pokémon you're searching fo

name: Gather
desc: Pokémon with the Gather specialty will pick up items on the ground and put them inside a community box

name: Gather Honey
desc: Pokémon with the Gather Honey specialty will give you special furniture if you bring them honey

name: Generate
desc: Pokémon with the Generate specialty can power machines with electricty

name: Grow
desc: Pokémon with the Grow specialty can make plants grow faster

name: Hype
desc: Pokémon with the Hype specialty will start dancing when they hear music, improving the mood

name: Illuminate
desc: Peakychu can use the Illuminate specialty to light up the whole town for you

name: Litter
desc: Pokémon with the Litter specialty will drop useful materials near their homes

name: Paint
desc: Smearguru has the Paint specialty and can recolor certain items, such as furniture

name: Party
desc: Chef Dente can use the Party specialty to help you prepare food for parties

name: Rarify
desc: Pokémon with the Rarify specialty can turn Star Pieces into rare Pokémetal

name: Recycle
desc: Pokémon with the Recycle specialty can process nonburnable garbage into iron ore and wastepaper into paper

name: Scrub
desc: Pokémon with the Scrub speciality clean grubby pearls into shiny pearls

name: Search
desc: Pokémon with the Search specialty can help you find buried items

name: Storage
desc: Pokémon with the Storage specialty can hold on to your items for you

name: Teleport
desc: Pokémon with the Teleport specialty can instantly take you to a Pokémon you're searching for

name: Trade
desc: Pokémon with the Trade speicalty can exchange items with you at a cash register

name: Transform
desc: Ditto can improve its moves by using Transform

name: Water
desc: Pokémon with the Water specialty can use a full water basin to spray water on nearby fields and plants

name: Yawn
desc: Pokémon with the Yawn specialty can tell you how humid it is
